about: The frame's update order before the system registry (refactor Phase 2 step 3): recorded on main 5e19b05 in Chrome (WebGPU, High), the storm golden's URL with birds=1, the third renderOnce() after boot, every module method the old drawOnce called wrapped in place. calls: the top-level calls in order (the renderer's own nested info.reset calls inside the Ultra read-back and the timestamp resolve left out; the second resolve is the Ultra FFT's compute queries; post.renderAsync sits between hud.render and hud.present and was not wrapped). recorded: the raw log.
